name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-channels
description: The five campaign channel child workflows (ADR 0157) — generate→approve DAGs the orchestration fans out over — migrated from the deprecated builtins (ADR 0472 P4). chainIds keep the original ids.

chains.label: Landing page
chains.description: Generate a campaign landing page from the brief, then approve.

briefId.description: The campaign brief to generate this channel from.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes (for example anthropic, openai, google). Fixed into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave unset to keep the nodes' own default.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by `provider` in the host catalog. Set it together with `provider`.

producedVariables.name: channelResult
producedVariables.description: This channel's result, {channel, draft} or {channel, skipped, reason}; an orchestration maps it out (ADR 1020 D2).

config.prompt: Review the generated landing page. Approve it to keep it; reject it to discard it.

inputs.summary: Skipped: this brief does not enable the landing page channel, so nothing was generated.
